title: Show HN: Oak – Git alternative designed for agents
summary: Oak is a version control system specifically designed for AI agents, featuring virtual mounts that allow agents to work on code without downloading a full repository copy. It solves the inefficiency of traditional Git in agent workflows by enabling parallel task execution without the overhead of complete repo duplication.
problem_solved: Traditional Git requires full repository copies and wastes agent time/resources when working on multiple tasks in parallel.
why_valuable: It dramatically improves agent efficiency by eliminating full repo downloads while maintaining full version control functionality.
